ai_summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited reported strong H1 FY27 revenue growth (+28% YoY), driven by explosive 94% growth in its Electronics Division and robust 41% growth in Consumer Durables, but faced significant profitability challenges with an adjusted loss in Q2 and a material exceptional loss of INR 132.2 crores in H1. Key material impacts include severe margin pressure across both the Consumer Durables and Railways divisions due to commodity inflation, currency fluctuations, and fixed-price contracts. While management projects these margin pressures are temporary and expects a rebound from Q2 FY28 for Railways, the company's high net debt of INR 2,582 crores and planned capex of up to INR 2,000 crores are notable, even as it diversifies into mobile manufacturing.
